description: This header file declares functions for parsing Intermediate Representation (IR) code into Torch's JIT graph structures. It provides interfaces to parse IR strings into a Graph object, optionally filling a value map and handling tensor constants.

methods.name: parseIR
methods.description: Parses IR code from a string into a Graph object. The function can optionally handle tensor constants by constructing empty tensors or throwing an exception if the syntax does not match expectations.

methods.name: parseIR
methods.description: Parses IR code from a string into a Graph object and fills a value map with name-value pairs for referencing Values in the IR. Tensor constants can be handled optionally.
